column1: # The robot markers of a date-analysis note (skills/date-analysis), on top of the
# shared list. Every row is a figure or an analyst word that the 2026-11-10 note on
# the second meeting with Jiyoung Kim used, and Chaehan called robotic on
# 2026-11-12: "took no exit, mechanisms, contrasts (and had not), her own line is
# closed". Run with the shared list and --strict, so the shared contrast frames
# Columns, tab-separated: level <TAB> pattern <TAB> fix <TAB> exception (optional).

column3: a figure: say what happened ("you stayed 8.5 hours and neither of you wanted to leave")
a figure for a person's view: say what she wants or does not want, in her words ("she would not want an open relationship herself")
a door figure for a view: say what she said she would or would not do
analyst word: say what you did ("you explained how mezcal is made")
analyst word: name what she did ("she stayed 8.5 hours and asked when you meet next")
a figure: say what she asked and how you answered
a figure: say the two facts and that they match
a clipped ending ("she wanted to ask and had not"): write the whole verb ("she had wanted to ask but did not dare") or two sentences
analyst frame: say what would make you think otherwise in plain words ("you would worry if she...")
a figure: say what she asked or did
a figure: say what they have in common ("her brother also works on AI")
analyst verb: use the everyday verb ("told you", "showed", "matters for")
a framing noun: state the fact itself
analyst words for talk: say who talked, how long, about what
a figure: say the plain fact ("her life is in Songpa", "she laughed")
a figure: give the date or the number of days
a form word: say what she looks for in a man, or what you will not accept, in plain words
in the running text, name the habit itself ("she counts her reasons"); the word trait stays in headings
a filler turn: drop it or give the time
analyst words: say what happened, and when ("after the third bar")
a frame: say what you still must ask her and why it matters to you
a lab word in a note about a person: say what she said and what it tells you about her
a ranking without its scale: say compared with what ("more than on 2026-11-09")
a guess about the future dressed as a check: give the quote that shows her the other way, or nothing
